about_short_description.short_description: Seam is a platform for managing any device

product.name: Seam API for IoT Devices
product.description: A unified API platform to connect, control, and manage a wide range of IoT devices including smart locks, thermostats, sensors, and access systems across multiple brands.

product.name: Smart Locks API
product.description: An API to control smart locks from various brands, allowing operations like locking, unlocking, access code management, and event monitoring through a single interface.

product.name: Access Control Systems API
product.description: An API to integrate and manage physical access control systems, including cloud-based and on-premises solutions, supporting credential issuance and user management.

product.name: Seam Bridge
product.description: A lightweight application that securely connects on-premises access control systems to the Seam cloud platform, enabling remote management without VPNs.

product.name: Seam Dashboard
product.description: A web-based interface for managing device fleets, monitoring device status, and coordinating operations across multiple locations.

product.name: Pre-built UI Components
product.description: A library of ready-made user interface components to quickly build device control interfaces that securely interact with Seam’s API.
